purpose.domain_detail: ATM banking demonstration: displays ATM-enabled accounts, validates user PIN via business logic programs BCASH10P and BCASH20P
purpose.summary: SCASH20P is the screen-handling layer of a CICS ATM demo application. It receives input either from a terminal screen or from an ATM channel (via COMMAREA), parses userid and PIN, calls business logic programs BCASH10P (PIN validation) and BCASH20P (account display), then returns results to the caller.

notable_features: EXEC CICS RECEIVE for terminal input
EXEC CICS LINK to business logic programs (BCASH10P, BCASH20P)
COPY books: CCASHDAT, CCASHEXT, CABENDD, CABENDPO
88-level condition names for input source and status flags
GO TO used for branching within paragraphs
Dual input path: screen vs ATM COMMAREA
